s26: Tell us about your menu and available space

zones: Plan the ingredient sinks, refrigerated prep counter and upright refrigerator around food storage and preparation. Check access, door swings and the route from storage to the cookline.

A pasta cooker, induction range, griddle, twin fryer and oven support different menu processes. Adjust the mix to your menu, then confirm electrical loads, heat rejection, hood coverage and maintenance access.
Arrange the work counter, bain-marie and clean-ware storage around the pass. Define hot-holding needs and how plating, pickup and replenishment work during peak service.

Use the scraping table, dedicated warewashing sinks and sanitizing cabinet to discuss used-ware handling. The beverage counter has its own sink and refrigeration. Review crossing routes and select the final cleaning process for the operation.
